subtitle: Games: Game Room: Freedoom, Tyrian, Quake, NES, Game Boy, PlayStation, PSP preview · Your games
connectHint: Park the car, power iDrive and connect your computer directly to the OBD port with an ENET cable. Enable temporary SSH using a tool for your exact firmware.
rememberLabel: Remember IPs, version and password on this PC
rememberTooltip: Saved to your Windows user profile; the password is encrypted so only your Windows account can read it back. Untick to delete what's saved.
recoverHint: An earlier operation left an installation lock. Close all other installer windows and confirm no other computer is installing to this car first.
uninstallHint: Removes the games (Game Room) from this head unit: the plugin from the iDrive and the game files from the hard drive. Saves and your own added games are kept on the car. Other apps on the head unit are not touched.
backupsHint: Each install or uninstall keeps one backup on the car (AppInstaller-Backup-…) so it can be undone. Deleting backups frees the space but removes that undo.
deleteBackups: Delete game backups on the car
diagnosticsHint: Pick what to collect. Read-only: nothing on the car changes. Everything is saved in a new folder on your Desktop.
diagDump: Crash dumps of the games and the iDrive (if any)
diag_processes: HMI threads and the game's processes
diag_watchdog: Crash dump list and watchdog freeze reports
statusCheckFingerprint: Check the fingerprint, then select Trust.
statusFinding: Looking for a gateway on the direct ENET link…
statusMultipleGateways: Multiple gateways replied. Select your car.
statusNoGateway: No ENET gateway replied. Check your cable, ignition and firewall, or enter both IPs manually.
statusFoundBoth: Head unit and gateway found. Connect or check compatibility.
statusFoundGatewayHaveHead: Gateway found. Using the head unit SSH IP already entered.
statusFoundGatewayOnly: Gateway found. Enter the SSH IP from your unlock tool.
statusInstalling: Installing and reading back all files…
statusDeletingBackups: Deleting backups on the head unit…
statusPullingDiagnostics: Pulling diagnostics from the head unit…
statusLoadedSaved: Loaded saved connection details. Select Find car, or Connect / Check compatibility directly.
statusWelcome: Connect the ENET cable and select Find car, or enter both IPs manually.
uninstallAllBody:
Remove the games (Game Room) from this head unit now?

The game files are deleted from the hard drive. Saves are kept. Other apps on the head unit are not touched.
uninstallSelectedBody:
Remove {apps} from this head unit now, leaving everything else installed as it is?

A backup of anything removed is kept on the car.
deleteBackupsBody:
Delete any old game backups (Game Room) left on the head unit by earlier installers?

Only game backups are deleted; other apps' backups are not touched.
errNeedCustomSize: Enter a whole pixel width of 800–1920 and height of 480–720.
errNeedDiagChoice: Tick at least one diagnostics item first.
errCarBusy: Still talking to the car from another request - wait for it to finish, then try again.
diag_games: Games: hard drive, game files, rebuild markers, saves
yoursHint: Add your own game files: NES (.nes), Game Boy and Game Boy Color (.gb, .gbc), PlayStation discs (.chd), PSP (.iso, .cso, .pbp, DVD-mode .chd), and your PlayStation BIOS (e.g. scph1001.bin), Doom IWADs (Doom, Doom II, Final Doom) and Quake (pak0/pak1, mission packs). Files are checked before copying; CHD console routing uses sector geometry, not decompressed game verification. .zip files are opened. Your games go on the car's hard drive and show up marked * in the game's list.
yoursSkipped: {count} other file(s) in the folder aren't game files and were skipped.
yoursCheckedStatus: Checked: {ok} can be added, {bad} can't (the reason is shown under each). Untick any you don't want, then select Add ticked games to the car.
addGames: Add ticked games to the car
carGamesEmpty: Select Show games on the car to see what's there.
removeGamesBody: Delete {count} of your game file(s) from the car's hard drive? Saves stay on the car. You can add them again later.
statusChoosing: Choose files in the window that opened…
statusAddingGames: Copying your games to the car's hard drive…
statusListingGames: Looking for your games on the car…
statesHint: Save states (Xbox button > Save state in a console game) are kept on the car's flash; a PlayStation one is about 5 MB. Game Room stops making them when less than 100 MB would be left. Show games on the car or Check compatibility shows the flash's free space.
deleteStatesBody: Delete every console-game save state on the car? Memory cards, battery saves and the other games' saves are kept.
statusDeletingStates: Deleting save states on the car…
dropNotSupported: Dragging files onto the installer isn't supported. To add your own games, use Choose files… or Choose folder… in Your games (card 5).
